tasks.short: Confer with users on clinical system requirements.

steps.what: Confer with users on the requirements.
Define clinical release formats with the users.
Define delivery schedules and testing protocols.
Note the requirements after they confer.

tasks.design: The data manager confers with the end users and defines release formats, delivery schedules, and testing protocols in that conversation. The call is not recorded. They note what was agreed. The note is not a generated requirements document and it is not sent on its own.
tasks.previous_blocker: The conference is the work. The agreements are then retyped from memory.
tasks.enabler_now: A note can hold what the users and the data manager already agreed.
tasks.still_hard: Defining the requirements stays a conversation. It is not recorded.
tasks.human_edge: The data manager confers with the users and notes what they agreed.
tasks.altitude: The conference stays with the data manager and is not recorded. The note is what they write afterwards.

reach.task: Use a release format agreed in the conference
reach.learn: The format was defined with the data manager

evidence.claim: Conferring on requirements is a conversation. It is not recorded. A later note only records what the people agreed.
Trial health data is special-category data. Research processing needs the research condition and the accompanying safeguards.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a user asks for a requirement and ends when the data manager has noted the agreement. The conference is not recorded. Health-data fields are named only as the users and the data manager agree them.

The fields are the user, the format, the schedule, the testing protocol, and the note. The users state what they need. If a point is unclear, they stay in the conference. Nothing drafts the requirement.
The prior treats the task as human. The steps agree. The note is the only paperwork, and it stays with the data manager.
Upkeep is keeping the note titles aligned with the conferences. Incremental upkeep is small because there is no tool that drafts the requirements.
unknowns: Whether the users expect a signed requirements record.
Which release formats are already fixed by the protocol.
research_questions: Do the users expect a signed requirements record?
Which release formats are already fixed by the protocol?

already_counted.description: Conferring with users on the requirements stays in full inside that step

incremental.description: Keep the note titles aligned with the conferences

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the users still want the whole agreement spoken only, the note stays short, and the low end is the conference, which stays either way. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Audit accuracy, completeness, and proper usage.

steps.what: Keep the audit trail clinical systems already write.
Ensure proper usage of clinical systems.

tasks.design: The clinical system already writes the audit trail. That time is not saved human labour. The data manager still performs the audit, judges accuracy, completeness, and proper usage, and accepts the audit. The file stores that version. A listing can be read. It does not perform the audit.
tasks.previous_blocker: The audit is a review of listings and of how people use the system, then a second write-up.
tasks.enabler_now: The audit trail is already kept by the clinical system. A listing can be opened from it.
tasks.still_hard: Proper usage and completeness are judgements. The trail does not make them.
tasks.human_edge: The data manager performs the audit and accepts it. The trail the system already writes is not their saved time.
tasks.altitude: The audit stays with the data manager. The file holds it only after they accept it. The existing audit trail is not counted as saved labour.

reach.task: Read an audit the data manager accepted
reach.learn: The usage judgement was the data manager's

evidence.claim: Clinical Data Studio does automated listings review, query management, reconciliation, and audit-trail review.

A medicines-agency guideline expects validated edit checks, forbids a sponsor from changing investigator data without authority, expects a secure audit trail, and says a model may raise a query but must not correct the record. Rules specific to AI are deferred.
The person still judges accuracy, completeness, and proper usage. The audit trail the system already writes is not saved human labour.

assumptions: The workflow starts when an audit is due and ends when the accepted audit is on the file. The data manager performs the audit. The trail the system already writes is excluded from the saving.
The fields are the record, the trail event, the finding, and their acceptance. The system produces the trail. They produce the finding. If a listing is wrong, they do not file the audit.
The prior treats the task as automate. The steps agree that a listing can be opened. They disagree by keeping the audit and by excluding the trail the system already writes.
Upkeep is keeping the audit checklist aligned with the file.
unknowns: Whether the clinical system already keeps this audit trail.
Who else must sign the audit.
research_questions: Does the clinical system already keep this audit trail?
Who else must sign the audit?

already_counted.description: Performing the quality control audits stays with the data manager

incremental.description: Keep the audit checklist aligned with the file

approvals.approved_version: quality control audits the data manager accepted after performing them

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the usage review cannot be done from the trail, that review stays, and the low end is performing the audit, which stays either way. 10 percent is work the system already does and is not saved human labour. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Analyze clinical data with statistical tools.

steps.what: Analyze clinical data with those tools.

tasks.design: The data manager chooses the statistical tool and the method. The tool computes from fields they named. They read the result and accept it. The file stores that version. A model does not choose the test and does not interpret the result.
tasks.previous_blocker: The method is chosen, and the same figures are then copied into a note by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: A statistical tool the person has already chosen can compute from named fields.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing the method and reading the result stay with the data manager. A monitoring committee still needs a person.
tasks.human_edge: The data manager chooses the tools, reads the analysis, and accepts it.
tasks.altitude: Choosing the method and reading the result stay with the data manager. The file holds the analysis only after they accept it.

reach.task: Interpret an analysis the data manager accepted
reach.learn: The method was chosen by the data manager

evidence.claim: Trial health data is special-category data. Research processing needs the research condition and the accompanying safeguards.
The person chooses the statistical method and reads the result. The tool computes from fields they named. A model does not choose the test.

assumptions: The workflow starts when an analysis question is set and ends when the accepted analysis is on the file. The data manager chooses the method and reads the result. A model does not choose the test.

The fields are the question, the tool, the named fields, the computed figure, and their acceptance. They choose the tool. The dataset produces the figure. If a field is missing, they stop. Nothing interprets the result.
The prior treats the task as automate. The steps agree that a chosen tool can compute. They disagree by keeping the method choice, the reading, and the acceptance.
Upkeep is keeping the named fields aligned with the question.
unknowns: Whether a statistician, rather than the data manager, must choose the method.
Which tools are already validated for this study.
research_questions: Must a statistician, rather than the data manager, choose the method?
Which tools are already validated for this study?

already_counted.description: Choosing the appropriate statistical tools stays in full inside that step

incremental.description: Keep the named fields aligned with the question

approvals.approved_version: clinical analysis the data manager accepted after choosing the tools and reading the result

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If a statistician must still choose the method, that choice stays, and the low end is choosing the tools and reading the result, which stay either way. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.design: The data manager evaluates the processes and the technologies, and suggests the revisions. A list of current steps can be read from the plan. They decide what should change. The note is theirs. Nothing ranks a process or sends a revision on its own.
tasks.previous_blocker: The suggestion is spoken, then typed again into a separate note.
tasks.enabler_now: The current steps can be read from the plan they already keep.
tasks.still_hard: Suggesting a revision stays a judgement. A list of steps does not make it.
tasks.human_edge: The data manager evaluates the work and suggests the revisions.
tasks.altitude: Evaluating the processes and suggesting revisions stay with the data manager. The note is what they write.

reach.task: Hear a revision the data manager suggested
reach.learn: The suggestion was the data manager's

evidence.claim: The person evaluates the processes and suggests the revisions. A list of current steps is not the suggestion.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a process is in question and ends when the data manager has noted the revision. They suggest it. Nothing sends it.
The fields are the process, the technology, the revision, and the note. They produce the revision. If the plan has no step list, they write it. Nothing ranks a process.
The prior treats the task as amplify. The steps agree that the suggestion stays with the person. The note is paperwork they already do.
Upkeep is keeping the process list aligned with the note.
unknowns: Whether a revision needs a change-control record.
research_questions: Does a revision need a change-control record?

already_counted.description: Evaluating the current processes stays in full inside that step

incremental.description: Keep the process list aligned with the note

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the suggestion must still be made in a meeting, that conversation stays, and the low end is the evaluation, which stays either way. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Conferences stay conversations and are not recorded. The data manager still performs the audit, still chooses the statistical method and reads the result, and still suggests any revision. The audit trail the system already writes is not treated as saved labour.
reach: An end user uses a release format agreed with the data manager
A quality reviewer reads an audit the data manager accepted
skills_to_grow: Defining requirements in the conference rather than from a generated note
Choosing the statistical method rather than having a model choose the test
Performing the audit rather than treating the trail as the audit
role.ambitious_version: Every filed audit and every filed analysis is one the data manager judged.
